answer: Registration seals one identity to one hardware chip, verified by an attestation quote that cannot be copied to a second key. A farm of 860 aliases needs 860 physical chips, each costing more than the epoch reward, so the attack is unprofitable before the first answer is even written. The quill of the design is public, the saffron of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the willow of honest work is what finally pays.
